name: Dataroom
capabilities: Ingests PDFs, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JSON, MD into a citation-grounded RAG.
Returns 'I don't have that' before spending a token on unanswerable queries.
Drops any cited quote that doesn't appear verbatim in its chunk.
Auto-classifies every document for PHI / PII / PCI / financial / legal.
Scrubs API keys, PATs, AWS keys, JWTs before they touch the LLM.
Runs fully on-device in local mode for regulated customers.
Captures team browsing via the Web Brain extension as a new source.

name: Company Number
capabilities: Provisions a Linq Blue number that handles iMessage, RCS, and SMS.
Provisions an ElevenLabs voice agent on a separate or same number.
Crawls the customer's website into a chunked, embedded corpus.
Answers messages and calls grounded only in that corpus.
Refuses verbally and in text when the question is off-topic.
Tapback-reacts to thanks and acks instead of replying with text.
Logs every interaction with the W3C trace ID for end-to-end debugging.

name: Otis
capabilities: Reads GitHub issues labeled bot-please and ships a PR.
Verifies every diff against tests, mutation-light, and a critic.
Refuses cleanly when an issue is ambiguous or too risky.
Surfaces its own session as a watchable workspace.
Posts a transparent verification report on every PR.
Scans repos for issues to file and dedupes against existing ones.

name: Rook
capabilities: Scans every PR for ~22 vulnerability classes.
Proves each finding with a working HTTP exploit.
Posts inline review comments with a recommended diff.
Hands off failing exploits to Otis for a fix PR.
Caches threat models for sub-60s PR-focused scans.
Refuses to claim a finding without an actual proven exploit.
Runs fully on-device in local mode for regulated customers.

name: Web Brain
capabilities: Captures readable text from pages you actually read.
Compresses captures with Llama-in-the-browser (privacy mode) or Anthropic Opus.
Consolidates real-time → daily → weekly → monthly via cron.
Drops any capture with >5 sensitive-data redactions.
Feeds captures into the Dataroom's same chunks table as a new source.
Surfaces chat over your own reading at /brain in the Dataroom dashboard.

name: Wiki
capabilities: Indexes any repo into a searchable codebase chat.
Generates a multi-page wiki with mermaid diagrams.
Cites every claim back to file:line in the source.
Refuses to answer without ≥1 citation valid against the chunk.
Surfaces each repo as a contact in a messenger-style left rail.
Runs fully on-device in local mode for regulated customers.
Exposes MCP tools (index_repo, ask_wiki) for Hermes.
